id: title:ReeceJones:clear idp config and org domain from scim provisioned user records when config is deleted

review.posthog_relevance: Database migration and cleanup of dependent records for IdentityProviderConfig, replacing CASCADE behavior with explicit clearing to prevent orphaned records.
review.reason: Adds migration 0063 to update FK behavior, explicitly clearing dependent records instead of cascading, and registers a pre_delete signal to handle cleanup. This is a substantive, bounded correctness and reliability improvement.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies on migration and signal implementation; actual runtime behavior and database compatibility are not demonstrated.

observations.limitations: This chunk represents a migration and model change. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F2.H1 establish the migration. P1.F3.H1 and P1.F3.H3 change the model and add a signal. P1.F4.H1 changes the API destroy behavior. P1.F5.H1 and P1.F5.H2 add tests. P1.F6.H1, P1.F6.H2, P1.F6.H3, P1.F6.H4 update signal receiver baselines. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds migration 0063, updating identity_provider_config FK to SET_NULL and removing CASCADE.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows clearing the FK reference without deleting dependent records, supporting the signal behavior.

observations.behavior: Adds pre_delete signal receiver to clear dependent records when IdentityProviderConfig is deleted.
observations.posthog_connection: Implements clearing of dependent SCIMProvisionedUser records and organization_domain when the parent config is deleted, replacing CASCADE behavior.
